name: CRUSH College
source:
Marriage is complicated, especially when you're part of the Carter family. Camilla has had enough of James skulking around, guilty and conflicted. Something is seriously wrong, so something has to change!

Sick of the housewife life, Camilla embarks on her own adventure, away from the family home. She's enrolled at the Cummingbrook Research University of Sexual Health!

What adventures will a confident, sexy, and mature student have around all these young, impressionable college co-eds? And can Camilla help her new friends when they find themselves in deep trouble?

Make friends, go out partying, attend class, join a band, enter a clinical trial, start a new business, or join a cult... it's all here at the orgasmic CRUSH College!

So, join MILF student Camilla now as she opens her mind (and her legs) in the most promiscuous college in the country! There must be something in the water!
